title: Audioman Doctor Result
description: Output envelope for `audioman doctor --json`. Reports one entry per executed analysis mode (linear, thd, imd, sweep, dynamics, attack_release, waveshaper, performance, clap, compare); a mode that fails stores {"error": "..."} instead of its measurement result. Mode keys are open-ended, so they are modelled via additionalProperties.

additionalProperties.description: One executed analysis mode: its measurement result, or {"error": ...} on failure.
